title: 토지개발 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to provide special provisions on registration of real estate where land registers have been rearranged following changes to parcels of land without land substitution in areas where land development projects are carried out under Article 86 of the Act on the Establishment and Management of Spatial Data, including urban development projects under the Urban Development Act, rural community improvement projects under the Rearrangement of Agricultural and Fishing Villages Act, and housing construction projects under the Housing Act.
